title: Roaring Stars
subtitle: The last photograph of the best howler, it's dizzying and dotted with shining stars.

trails.title: The Woodlands
trails.description: The branches are denser and the rain more sparse. Rather than rush on ahead, many creatures choose to pause here instead.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It escaped, taking my precious collection away.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nah, there's no way to follow it. The trees it pushed down have blocked the path. This would take us some time.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That was definitely not your usual critter. Ms. Tooth Fairy, what kind of traces did you find earlier?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Most of them were left by medium and small critters. Claw marks of giant critters are clear but few. There's probably one critter of such an immense size.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Besides, we need to offer an explanation to that lady.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Of course.
They all look at the center of the chaos, who seems to feel the gazes and turn back in confusion.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Why are you all staring at me? Do I have something on my face or my clothes?
Tooth Fairy turns her face to the film crew. The actors stand in a circle, with fake blood all over their bodies. Blonney lets out a mournful cry.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Camera, my camera, my God. The roll films are ruined, too.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: There, there, Jennifer.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Perhaps I can try piecing it together and fix it for you. Would it help you to feel better?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It's no use. Everything in it has gone—every take I took!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Yeah, like what Anne said, don't be sad. Thanks to your generosity, none of us were injured.
Blonney looks up, and the brittle pieces of burnt camera fall to the ground from her hand.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: What did you just say?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I'm trying to comfort you. Don't glare at me. Actually, I think this is unnecessary, but they made me.
The young man lowers his head, keeps his voice down, and tilts his head toward the people behind him.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: See? Behind me, the girl with the hat and the girl in the white …

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ah, unnecessary? You think it's unnecessary? Do you have even the slightest idea of what you have destroyed?
The blonde girl is shaking. Her face is clouded with anger.
Her manicured nails nearly poke Horropedia's nose like sharpened little knives.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Make your four eyes useful and look at these. What do you think they are?!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Alright, calm down. Let's be reasonable.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: If you were mad because of your movie, I am really sorry. But at that very moment, I thought our safety mattered the most.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Also, I have good news for you. This Recorder is meant for taking daily family videos. The clips taken by it aren't nearly enough to be called a movie.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: So, to some extent, I just prevented you from shooting a disastrous movie.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: If you are looking for any financial compensation, please talk to the girl with the hat.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ugh, ah! Come again? Who is going to make a disastrous movie? Ugh, no, don't change the subject!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Movies, ha! No, I'm not raging over some movies. I don't care about this stupid s**t at all!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You think money can get you out of trouble? It doesn't even come close! That was a limited collaboration product of Recorder and Lugus. You can only find three of these all over the world. Only three!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It's more valuable than any jewelry or luxury handbags!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: The suede decoration on it alone can buy 200 of your stupid head, dumbass!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Shoot! My makeup!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: What are you sticking there for? Go clean the broken trunks and branches off the path! We have to get back to the cabin as soon as possible. I have no desire to catch a cold in the rain!
Someone comes to her side.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: This is not a safe place for you. Get back to the town, find a hotel, and take a hot shower.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: My students and I will escort you to the main road at the edge of the woods and arrange a car for you.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: If any of you have symptoms like an itchy throat or rising temperature, please buy some Robitussin or similar drug at the nearest pharmacy.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ah! No, I'm not leaving! The movie is not finished.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: As long as you take care of that big monster, I can continue with my project to get that stupid s**t movie done.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: But, we don't have that cam- ... camer- ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Camera! You dumb girl!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You have no idea what we are doing here, so don't tell me what to do if the best you could do is handcraft some props!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Staying here is really not a wise choice for you.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It is very dangerous, and you can't protect yourselves.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It's our right to stay here. You can't just expel us.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You are, of course, entitled of the right to stay, Ms. Blonney.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: But I hope you could keep in mind that you and your friends are in grave danger. The Green Lake Campsite is not a place for fun.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You should stay with us for the sake of your safety.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The rain is getting heavier. We might catch a cold. Let's clean up the road and head for the shelter.
The blonde girl falls silent for a brief moment and then storms away.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: All this gibberish is to scare us off. Come here, Freddie!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Go into the campsite and see if you can find some axes for us.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Kids, if you find any teeth, please pick them up and hand them to me.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Hurry up, Freddie. I'm freezing!
